Hi all —

Thanks for your interest in a hands-on showcase of Redwood Inference. We want to run a compact evening "cohort" that lets multiple prospects get a focused walk-through without the full webinar overhead. Proposal: we run back-to-back 30-minute demo blocks (technical deep-dive + Q&A) and keep a short waitlist for overflow.

Quick details:
- Goal: show deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and cost/latency tradeoffs for inference workloads
- Format: 30 min per company (20 min demo + 10 min targeted Q&A)
- Proposed windows (PDT): 18:00–20:30 on Tue 26 May (3 slots), or 19:00–21:30 on Wed 27 May (3 slots)
- We’ll rotate presenters so each slot has an engineer and an account rep.

Attached: brief agenda and a sample slot-assignment CSV. If you can share preferred days/times + number of attendees, I’ll carve you a slot and update the waitlist. If these evenings don’t work, suggest alternatives and we’ll attempt a staggered plan across two evenings.

Thanks — looking forward to getting everyone in a focused session.
